theorem Erdos1122.Core.isScaledLogOnPos_of_isLittleO_descentCount_of_hasBoundedDownwardJumps_of_shell_descent_card_le
  {f : Nat → Real} (hf : Erdos1122.IsCoprimeAdditive f)
  (ho : Asymptotics.IsLittleO Filter.atTop (fun X => ↑(Erdos1122.descentCount f X)) fun X => ↑X) {D : Real}
  (hD : Erdos1122.HasBoundedDownwardJumps f D) {K : Nat}
  (hcard :
    ∀ (u : Nat),
      LE.le 1 u →
        LE.le (Finset.card (Inter.inter (Finset.Ico u (HMul.hMul 2 u)) (Erdos1122.descentFinset f (HMul.hMul 2 u))))
          K) :
  And (∀ (m : Nat), LE.le 1 m → Eq (f m) (HMul.hMul (HDiv.hDiv (f 2) (Real.log 2)) (Real.log ↑m)))
    (Erdos1122.IsScaledLogOnPos f)

theorem Erdos1122.Core.isScaledLogOnPos_of_isLittleO_descentCount_of_hasBoundedDownwardJumps_of_bitLength_zero_shell_bound
  {f : Nat → Real} (hf : Erdos1122.IsCoprimeAdditive f)
  (ho : Asymptotics.IsLittleO Filter.atTop (fun X => ↑(Erdos1122.descentCount f X)) fun X => ↑X) {D B : Real}
  (hD : Erdos1122.HasBoundedDownwardJumps f D)
  (hB :
    ∀ (u : Nat), LE.le 1 u → ∀ (q : Nat), LE.le u q → LT.lt q (HMul.hMul 2 u) → LE.le (abs (HSub.hSub (f q) (f u))) B) :

core_notation_audit.name: Erdos1122.Core.erdos_1122_of_boundedDownwardJumps_and_subshell_downward_drift
core_notation_audit.declaration:
theorem Erdos1122.Core.erdos_1122_of_boundedDownwardJumps_and_subshell_downward_drift
  (hjump :
    ∀ (f : Nat → Real),
      Erdos1122.IsCoprimeAdditive f →
        (Asymptotics.IsLittleO Filter.atTop (fun X => ↑(Erdos1122.descentCount f X)) fun X => ↑X) →
          Exists fun D => Erdos1122.HasBoundedDownwardJumps f D)
  (hdrift :
    ∀ (f : Nat → Real),
      Erdos1122.IsCoprimeAdditive f →
        (Asymptotics.IsLittleO Filter.atTop (fun X => ↑(Erdos1122.descentCount f X)) fun X => ↑X) →
          Exists fun M =>
            ∀ (u : Nat),
              LE.le 1 u →
                ∀ (q : Nat),
                  LE.le u q →
                    LE.le q (HMul.hMul 2 u) →
                      And (LE.le (HSub.hSub (f u) (f q)) M) (LE.le (HSub.hSub (f q) (f (HMul.hMul 2 u))) M)) :
  Erdos1122.Erdos1122Conjecture
